industrialRegions.drivers: Cotton textile origin, cheap hydel power from Western Ghats (Tata Hydro), Bombay High oil & petrochemicals, financial capital access, engineering, IT (Pune), and automobile hub.
Jute textile belt along Hooghly river, early British capital, proximity to Raniganj coal and Damodar mineral hinterland, cheap labour from Bihar/Odisha, Kolkata port.

Heavy public sector investment (HAL, BHEL, ISRO), Pykara & Mettur hydel power, cotton textiles (Coimbatore Manchester of South India), IT & electronics (Bengaluru), automobile and hardware cluster (Chennai).
Black soil cotton belt, petrochemicals and refineries (Kandla, Jamnagar, Dahej), chemical and pharmaceutical corridors, diamond cutting (Surat), port-led industrial growth.
The Ruhr of India — co-location of Gondwana coal (Jharia, Bokaro), high-grade hematite iron ore (Singhbhum, Kendujhar), manganese, limestone, and water from DVC; heavy engineering and steel plants.
